study_design.primary_method: Proportional allocation by automated support label using largest remainders; seeded SHA-256 ranking without replacement within each stratum.
study_design.supplement_method: Given the primary sample, repeatedly allocate one slot to the least represented automated diagnosis, tie-breaking in frozen diagnosis order. Cap total contradiction units at 40 to retain calibration-eligible units. Uniform seeded ranking within the remaining diagnosis pool.
study_design.presentation_order: Independent seeded SHA-256 ranking across all 600 selected units; group membership is private.
study_design.calibration: Not conducted or generated. Future calibration must use units outside these 600; at least two automated contradictions remain available.
study_design.estimand: Primary: claim-level agreement within the completed frozen BACE DC inventory, conditional on original candidate EC inputs.
study_design.analysis_rule: Use the 400 primary units and their stratum weights for overall estimates. Supplement inclusion probabilities are conditional on the realized primary sample; do not treat all 600 as an unweighted representative sample or these probabilities as unconditional union probabilities.

scope: Only local formal workbook copies inspected; annotations elsewhere are not inferred absent.
